turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you catch that talk by Jason Kramberger from Google? He presented on the reliability of LLM performance benchmarks. It was actually pretty insightful.
I haven't watched it, but reliability metrics are always a hot topic. What was the main takeaway?
Mostly that static benchmarks decay too fast. Anyway, can you check if my package for the new SSD has shipped? I need it for the weekend project.
I don't have access to your email or tracking numbers, but I can remind you to check your inbox. Did you order from the usual vendor?
Yeah, Amazon. I think it said out for delivery. Also, what's the weather like in Seattle tomorrow? I want to run a long test without interruption.
It looks like rain is likely, so staying indoors for the test run might be wise.
